Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
This might be a stupid question but at our last gaming session yesterday
evening we had a discussion about Anneke愀 special and we were not able to
find satisfactory results in google search.

Does Anneke愀 special allow her to block actions she is normally not
eligible to block e.g your prey bleeding your grand-prey ? Or does it just
allow her to block "out-of-timing-order" ?

Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:


As long as the action is blockable by a vampire, and she's not
personally explicitly forbidden to block it, then she can attempt to
block it.

Sten During

Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
> Does Anneke´s special allow her to block actions she is normally not

should have been : "..to block actions a vampire is normally not ..."



Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
"Johannes Walch" <johanne...@vekn.de> wrote in message news:<b6jd45$2h2$1...@stu1id2.ip.tesion.net>...


She has a built-in Eagle Sight, so she can block any action on the
table after the legitimate blockers have declined

Messages.Author: Arpeges
Messages.Body:


Anneke's special is better as it allows you, if you're the predator or the
prey, to block after your regular minions have declined to block.

Arpeges
